title: A Practical End-to-End Inventory Management Model with Deep Learning
authors: Meng Qi; Yuanyuan Shi; Yongzhi Qi; Chenxin Ma; Rong Yuan; Di Wu; Zuo‐Jun Max Shen
eligible_reason: Single common treatment date, not staggered. JD.com field experiment: 6,097 (SKU, DC) pairs switched to the E2E replenishment algorithm on March 30, 2020, compared with a propensity-score-matched control group. Table 4 is a 2x2 pre/post comparison of group means (pre Feb 29-Mar 29 vs post Mar 30-Apr 30, 2020); Tables 2-3 are post-period t-tests and cross-sectional OLS.
design_notes: Field_experiments_summary.ipynb: sm.OLS(outcome ~ Is-E2E + Ave-Demand + Ave-VLT) cross-sectional; Table 4 DiD computed from group means. Propensity_score_matching.ipynb selects controls on demand and VLT.
data_files_note: README: 500 randomly sampled (SKU, DC) pairs per group with desensitized IDs; original-data outputs given as PDF logs.
data_provenance_note: README states the treatment/control order files are random samples of 500 (SKU, DC) pairs because the original data are too large to disclose.
software_notes: Python notebooks (statsmodels; PyTorch for the E2E model)
